Reading a Python traceback

When your script crashes you'll see something like this:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/alice/app.py", line 3, in <module>
    print(1 / 0)
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

Django shows a yellow page saying You're seeing this error because you have <code>DEBUG = True</code>.

A MySQL injection bug often prints:

You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax

And Java prints frames like at com.example.Main.run(Main.java:10).
